title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
扑通！！这一切都发生在电光火石之间。等到这两人毙命倒地时，脸上仍带有不敢置信之色。而陆白抬手抹了抹自己脸上仍然温热的血，直到这时才完全放松了下来。“呼......”不敢耽误时间的他拔出另外一只手掌上钉着的匕首，迅速割断绳索站了起来。然后半蹲下身，拿起了那名光头大汉手里的枪，轻轻推开了房间门。“我要用我的歌词撕裂一切，直到我粉身碎骨，直到屋顶掀翻......”入目是炫目的灯光以及有些刺耳的黑人说唱rap。几个穿着宽大T恤的黑人正聚在走廊里一起抽着大麻吞云吐雾。其中一个发现了走出房间的陆白，抬起手刚想说话。陆白毫不犹豫地抬起枪口，连续扣动扳机。砰砰！！三人胸口几乎同时炸开血花，倒地毙命。整个过程如同行云流水般没有超过三秒。但抬头看了一眼走廊上方的摄像头。陆白知道自己还是暴露了。他经过增强之后的听力，能够听到起码有不下二十人正持枪朝这边快速赶来。酒吧的金属大门也被重重关上。陆白见此想了想。找了个房间走进去，发动白泽精怪图的穿越能力，身影瞬间消失。下一刻。他出现在一个像是放大版原始森林的地方。入目所见。随便一颗树的直径都超过了十几米，甚至还有更粗更大的。从远处传来了不知名野兽的嘶吼声，恍如重鼓般敲击在陆白的心头。这里就是山海经的世界？！陆白打量着四周。放眼望去所有的东西基本都比自己大，要说他心里完全不慌是不可能的。

不过好在他这个人最大的优点就是适应能力比较强。在原地感受了会儿这里异常清新的空气之后，陆白沿着一条看起来比较安全的路向前。阳光透过茂密的树冠，在弥散着薄雾的林地上投下斑驳的影子。随着探索的深入，一个瑰丽奇异的大世界向着陆白徐徐掀开了面纱的一角。他在这里看到了高达一层楼的鲜艳蘑菇，也有展开直径超过两米的巨大花朵。在不考虑危险的情况下，这里的可游玩性可能远超地球上任何一个旅游景点。但伴随着一阵令人感到不安的嗡嗡声传来，陆白觉得自己可能需要收回上面那句话。一群比手臂还要粗的蚊虫成群结队从他面前飞过。那气势像是大军在出行。一些藏在落叶中的昆虫可能是被他的脚步声惊动，从里面爬出来磨盘大小的昆虫，大腿粗的蜈蚣。！！！这一路上的见闻让陆白大开眼界。同时他也发现了似乎是因为白泽精怪图的原因。这里大部分生物并不会攻击自己。一群比亚洲象还大、双目闪动着瘆人红芒的白狼除外。“嗷呜呜！！”陆白毫无征兆地就被这群看起来就十分不好惹的巨狼包围了。在连续开了十几枪都没卵用之后。他瞬间从优哉游哉的游客模式，开始了亡命奔逃。“嗬嗬......”不知道跑了多久。直到陆白这具经过强化的身体都有些撑不住的时候。他终于跑出了那片原始森林的范围，面前是一座高耸入云端的巨大山峰。那群白狼像是忌惮山上什么东西一样，在森林边缘止步不前，朝陆白发出一声声不甘的嘶吼。“呼......累死我了。”陆白没有在意这些败犬的狂吠，用手撑着膝盖大口喘着气。也幸好他用白泽精怪图里储存的愿力，加强了一波自己的体质。不然的话。
content_en:
thump!!It all happened in the blink of an eye.When the two men fell to the ground dead, there was still a look of disbelief on their faces.Lu Bai raised his hand and wiped the still warm blood on his face, and only then did he completely relax."Huh..." Not daring to waste time, he pulled out the dagger nailed to his other hand, quickly cut the rope and stood up.Then he squatted down, picked up the gun in the bald man's hand, and gently opened the door to the room."I'm going to tear everything apart with my lyrics, until I'm broken into pieces, until the roof falls off..." What you can see is the dazzling lights and some harsh black rap.Several black men wearing baggy T-shirts were gathering in the corridor, smoking marijuana and puffing away.One of them noticed Lu Bai walking out of the room, raised his hand and was about to speak.Lu Bai raised the muzzle of the gun without hesitation and pulled the trigger continuously.Bang bang!!The three people's chests exploded with blood almost at the same time, and they fell to the ground dead.The whole process took no more than three seconds.But he looked up at the camera above the corridor.Lu Bai knew that he was still exposed.With his enhanced hearing, he could hear at least twenty people rushing towards this direction with guns in hand.The metal door of the bar was also slammed shut.Seeing this, Lu Bai thought for a while.He found a room and walked in, activated Bai Ze Jinggui Tu's ability to travel through time, and his figure disappeared instantly.The next moment.He appeared in a place that looked like an enlarged version of the primeval forest.What you see.The diameter of any tree is more than ten meters, and there are even thicker and bigger ones.The roar of an unknown beast came from the distance, beating in Lu Bai's heart like a heavy drum.Is this the world of Shan Hai Jing?!Lu Bai looked around.Everything he looked at was basically bigger than himself, so it was impossible to say that he was not at all panicked.

Fortunately, his biggest advantage is his ability to adapt.After feeling the unusually fresh air here for a while, Lu Bai moved forward along a road that seemed safer.The sun shines through the dense canopy of trees, casting mottled shadows on the misty forest floor.As the exploration deepened, a corner of the veil of a magnificent and strange world slowly opened to Lu Bai.Here he saw brightly colored mushrooms as high as one storey, and huge flowers with a diameter of more than two meters.Without considering the danger, the playability here may far exceed any tourist attraction on the planet.But as a disturbing buzzing sound came, Lu Bai felt that he might need to take back the above sentence.A swarm of mosquitoes thicker than an arm flew past him.The momentum was like a large army traveling.Some insects hiding in the fallen leaves may have been disturbed by his footsteps, and insects the size of millstones and centipedes with thick thighs crawled out.!!!What he saw along the way opened Lu Bai's eyes.At the same time, he also discovered that it seemed to be due to the ghost picture of Bai Ze.Most creatures here will not attack themselves.Except for a group of white wolves that were larger than Asian elephants and had eyes flashing with scary red light."Ouch!!" Lu Bai was surrounded by this group of giant wolves that looked very untouchable without any warning.After firing more than a dozen shots in succession to no avail.He instantly went from the leisurely tourist mode to running on the run."Ho ho..." I don't know how long I ran.Until Lu Bai's strengthened body couldn't hold it any longer.He finally ran out of the virgin forest, and in front of him was a huge mountain peak that towered into the clouds.The group of white wolves seemed to be afraid of something on the mountain. They stopped at the edge of the forest and roared unwillingly at Lu Bai."Huh... I'm so exhausted." Lu Bai didn't pay attention to the barking of these defeated dogs, holding his knees with his hands and gasping for air.Fortunately, he used the wish power stored in the Bai Ze Jinggui Tu to strengthen his own physique.otherwise.
